**1. What "backpressure" means here:**
Think of backpressure like traffic control when a highway gets jammed. The system is receiving more data than it can currently handle, so it is signaling upstream components to slow down and hold off on sending low-priority data (like non-critical metrics) until the system can catch up.

**2. Are accepted payment events dropped?**
**No.** Payment events that have already been accepted are kept safe in the pending queue and will not be dropped.
